title: Confirm product truth for Tamagn Check
question: Confirm these facts so we can build the session-open loading experience. Pick the option that matches, or steer with a correction.

options.label: Yes — build with these facts
options.thesis: Tamagn Tech (ታማኝ ቸክ) verifies Ethiopian payment receipts (Telebirr, CBE, Dashen, BOA) via screenshot, QR, payment ID, or SMS.
options.viewport: Primary users: people and businesses who must trust a receipt is real before releasing goods or cash. After splash: active session → home/dashboard; no session → login. Keep existing brand (ink, birr green, foil gold, parchment).
options.risk: If any of this is wrong, steer with the correct audience or routing.

options.label: Guests always land on Login after splash
options.thesis: Same product facts, but cold open never shows marketing home — splash then Login when logged out, Dashboard/Admin when logged in.
options.viewport: Marketing home at / remains reachable later; first open is splash → session gate.
options.risk: Removes the public home as first paint for new visitors.

options.label: Keep marketing Home for guests
options.thesis: Same product facts. Splash then Home for guests, Dashboard/Admin when logged in — Login only when they choose it.
options.viewport: Splash replaces skeleton only; routing after session matches today’s HomePage redirects.
options.risk: Slightly softer than “open login if no cookie”.
